legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment is freely assignable by Assignee, and Assignor hereby consents to such assignment.
legal_clauses.indemnification: Assignor agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Assignee against any and all claims, demands, or causes of action.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any dispute arising out of or related to this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: Assignee shall be responsible for all closing costs and obligations, including but not limited to transfer taxes, title insurance, and settlement fees.
